nodes.question: What effect do fleet-related measures have on emissions in the evaluated policy packages?
nodes.answer: When fleet-related measures are included along with activity-related measures, emissions can be reduced to 0.4 million tonnes of CO2 equivalents, showing a significant decrease of 94.2%.

nodes.answer: Daily files were on average 25% of the original VP file size, and monthly files were 6%.
